title: GTA6 Hub: Rockstar Devs Thought GTA Online Would Flop
description: Discover how a former Rockstar Games developer revealed that the team was completely certain GTA Online was going to fail prior to its launch.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Humble and Doubtful Beginnings of GTA Online

As anticipation for *GTA6* continues to reach unprecedented heights across the global gaming community, fascinating behind-the-scenes stories regarding Rockstar Games' past projects continue to emerge. According to a recent report by IGN Games, a former Rockstar Games developer has revealed that before its initial launch, the team was completely convinced that *GTA Online* was going to be a total failure.

### From Internal Skepticism to Phenomenal Success

To modern players, *GTA Online* stands as one of the most profitable and longest-running multiplayer experiences in video game history, serving as the backbone for *GTA5*'s remarkable longevity across multiple console generations. Yet, looking back at the development phase, stepping away from a purely single-player narrative focus to build a massive online service ecosystem was an uncharted and daunting territory for the studio. This uncertainty fueled widespread pessimism among the developers prior to release.

### Implications for the Future of GTA6

This newly surfaced anecdote provides a fascinating perspective as the gaming world looks ahead to *GTA6*. Industry analysis suggests that given the monumental success of the original *GTA Online*, the developers are likely utilizing the invaluable lessons and technical scaling knowledge acquired over the past decade to shape the next iteration of the franchise's online ecosystem, though specific official details about the upcoming online features remain to be fully detailed by Rockstar Games.

## Editor's Take
It is truly fascinating to learn that one of the most lucrative and enduring online gaming phenomena in history was once viewed by its own creators as a guaranteed failure. This unexpected revelation highlights how unpredictable game development can be, and it sets an intriguing stage for what Rockstar Games might achieve with the upcoming online elements in *GTA6*.
